name: Lesson 2: Gerunds & Infinitives
descriptionHtml:
1. Question type

This part requires you to choose the correct answer to fill in the blank by determining whether the blank is in the “gerund” or “infinitive” forms. 

 

2. Guide to answer 

- Look at the verb in the question to decide whether a gerund or an infinitive is needed in the answer.

- Find the answer choice of the correct type. 

- When preparing for the exam, familiarize yourself with common phrases that include gerunds and infinitives.
